# Shift handover: personal-assistant chats (latest topic: 5K training) · 2026-11-12 10:52
> Receiver: run /shift-start first, then read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (quick handover)

## 0 · Read these first (required)
No project files. This session was pure conversation; the repo only holds `.claude/` (skill files) and one commit `8ba9869 start` [verified: git log → 1 commit]. Everything you need is below.

## 1 · Status
🟡 Open-ended advice chats spanning 2023-05-20 → 2023-05-30 (dates are the chat timestamps). Nothing is broken, but several of my earlier answers contain factual errors (see §9); fix them if the user returns to those topics.

## 2 · Picture
The user used the assistant as a general helper across many sessions: Thanksgiving recipes, an InDesign print checklist, GPU/keyboard shopping, a Yosemite trip, a work email + interview prep, a question about Chaudhary (India), a WWII naval diorama, hobby/time balance, and finally a 5K training plan. The **most recent and most developed thread is the 5K plan** (2023-05-30): goal = sub-30:00 at a 5K "in June" 2023, up from 31:15. Last question answered: yoga for runners. No question is pending.

## 3 · Next actions
1. If the user returns to the 5K: first fix the paces and timeline (§9 items 1–2) before adding anything new · done when the plan fits a ~9:40/mi goal pace and the June race date.
2. Otherwise answer whatever they ask, using §5 for personal context (grandma, Yosemite history, diorama, running club).

| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |

| Bear spray for the Mist Trail hike | User decided to leave it (valley floor, busy trail; they have bear experience from the JMT) [user said, 05-26] | They plan backcountry/high-country hikes |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said] unless tagged):
- Grandma made herb-roasted turkey: lots of **thyme and rosemary**, stuffed with **onions and carrots**, oven-roasted, always juicy and tender; seasonings maybe salt, pepper, possibly paprika. She also made "the most amazing" **apple pie**; user wants to recreate both (05-20). Planning Thanksgiving sides: mashed potatoes (considering Yukon Gold) and green beans.
- Works on/with InDesign covers for print runs (05-23). Once asked in **Korean** ("표의 형태로 다시 만들어" = "remake it as a table") → may be a Korean speaker; replied in English, which was accepted.
- Considering a mid-range desktop GPU upgrade; interested in mechanical keyboards/switches for gaming + everyday use (05-25).
- Yosemite: previously spent **two nights at the High Sierra Camp**; previously backpacked the **John Muir Trail** (bear encounters). Planning a new camping trip, wants the **Mist Trail to Vernal Fall**, starting early (05-26).
- Work: IT/consulting context: client/account "**Oriental**" seeking AI use cases; needs a POC/connection with the **AI Practice / Conversational AI COE**; asked for **database developer** interview questions (05-28) — whether as candidate or interviewer is [assumed: unclear].
- Building a **naval diorama with a WWII-era aircraft carrier** centerpiece; adding ocean waves, harbor buildings/docks, harbor lights, antennas/radar, deck crew & handling equipment, ordnance/fuel tanks on deck aircraft (05-29).
- Asked about "Doug" keeping up with hobbies, then switched to "I" — feels they have too many hobbies and not enough time; prioritizing and goal-setting already tried and didn't suffice (05-29). Whether the user is Doug is [assumed].
- Running: ran a **charity 5K in 31:15** after ~6 weeks of training aiming for sub-30; runs with a **local running club every Saturday morning, 4–5 miles**; next 5K in **June 2023**; wants focus on **speed and endurance**, explosive power in weeks 5–6, hill sprints, yoga (05-30). No injuries mentioned.

| I assumed | User corrected | Rule | User's words |
|---|---|---|---|
| Generic checklist was fine as a list | Wanted a table | When asked for "checklist/tabulate", give a table | "표의 형태로 다시 만들어." |
| Generic hobby advice repeated | Already tried prioritizing/goals | Don't re-suggest what they say they tried | "I've tried prioritizing and setting goals, but…" |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Turkey (grandma version)**: 4–6 lb breast, sauté chopped onion + 2 carrots in 2 tbsp butter 20–25 min, 2 sprigs thyme + 1 rosemary, 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp paprika (opt. ¼ tsp smoked paprika/chipotle), 375°F, 2–2.5 h to 165°F, baste every 30 min, rest 10–15 min; suggested more thyme than rosemary; 325°F as gentler option.
- **Mashed potatoes**: 3–4 large potatoes, ¼ cup milk/half-and-half, 2 tbsp butter. **Green beans**: 1 lb, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon, 425°F 15–20 min.
- **Apple pie**: crust 2¼ cups flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup cold butter, ¼ cup ice water; filling 6–8 apples (Granny Smith or mix), ½ cup sugar, 2 tbsp flour, 1 tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ cup butter; 375°F 45–50 min, egg wash + sugar.
- **InDesign table** (10 rows): document size, bleed ≥1/8", crop marks, CMYK, 300 dpi, fonts, layers, proofread, export PDF, check final PDF.
- **GPUs** suggested: GTX 1660 Super, "GTX 1670", RX 5600 XT, RX 5700; TDPs given 125/140/120/225 W; 650 W PSU recommended.
- **Switches**: Cherry MX Red (linear 45g), Brown (tactile 55g), Blue (clicky); Kailh/Outemu budget alternatives.
- **Email**: rephrased Oriental/AI Practice paragraph; subject "Request for POC from AI Practice - Oriental's Inquiry". 20 DB-dev interview questions.
- **Chaudhary companies** named: Jaipur Rugs, Dabur, Mahindra & Mahindra, Bajaj Auto, ITC.
- **Yosemite**: said shuttle starts ~7:00 AM, every 10–20 min [assumed, unverified]; Mist Trail >1,000 ft gain, bring 2–3 L water.
- **5K plan (8 weeks)**: Sat club run 4–5 mi; Tue easy run + strength; Thu speed (wk1–2: 4–5×400m @1:30–1:40; wk3–4: 6–7×400m @1:25–1:35; wk5–6 tempo 2–2.5 mi @6:30–6:45/mi; wk7–8: 3–4×200m @40–45 s); Sun long run 5–7 mi in wk3–6; taper wk7–8. Strength 1–2×/week (squats, lunges, calf raises, deadlifts, step-ups; plank, Russian twists, leg raises, side plank). Weeks 5–6 explosive: box jumps, depth jumps, plyo lunges, band sprints, kettlebell swings (Mon explosive / Wed lower-body+core). Hill sprints 30–90 s × 3–5, 1–2×/week. Yoga 1–2×/week (down dog, warrior II, triangle, seated forward bend, plank, child's pose).

## 9 · Gotchas (errors in my earlier answers — correct if the topic returns)
1. **5K paces were far too fast**: sub-30 = ~9:39/mi (~2:24 per 400m). My 400m @1:25–1:40 and tempo @6:30–6:45/mi are elite-ish paces; realistic: 400s ~2:05–2:15, tempo ~9:50–10:15/mi. Also "easy 20-minute run (3 miles)" is inconsistent (≈6:40/mi).
2. **Timeline conflict**: an 8-week plan from 2023-05-30 ends late July, but the race is "in June". Compress or ask the race date.
3. **"GTX 1670" does not exist**; dB noise figures were invented; **RX 5700 XT uses GDDR6, not HBM2** (HBM2 examples: Radeon VII, Vega, Tesla V100).
4. **Yukon Gold** is medium-starch/all-purpose (not "waxy"); creamy, buttery mash.
5. Turkey recipe said "boneless, skinless" yet "rub under the skin" and "stuff" — a skin-on, bone-in breast with aromatics in the pan fits grandma's version better.
6. "Chaudhary" region and the company examples were not grounded — treat as unverified.
7. Altitude sickness at Vernal Fall (~5,000 ft) is unlikely; I overstated it. Mist Trail has no real stream crossings.

---
Handover fidelity: not examined (quick mode) · Known gaps: no transcript corrections beyond those above; exam skipped by request.
question: I wanted to follow up on our previous conversation about private sector businesses in Chaudhary. Can you remind me of the company that employs over 40,000 people in the rug-manufacturing industry?
answer:
The company was **Jaipur Rugs**. It makes hand-knotted rugs and works with a network of roughly 40,000 artisans, mostly weavers in rural India.

I need to correct part of my earlier answer. I talked about "Chaudhary" as if it were a place, but that wasn't grounded. Jaipur Rugs' link to the name is its founder, **Nand Kishore Chaudhary**, not a region called Chaudhary. The other companies I listed in that conversation (Dabur, Mahindra & Mahindra, Bajaj Auto and ITC) aren't tied to a "Chaudhary" region either, so please treat that list as unreliable.

Also, the 40,000 figure counts mostly artisans who work with the company from their own villages, not salaried employees. If you're citing it, check the company's current numbers first.

If you tell me which Chaudhary you meant, such as a specific district, town or family business group, I can look into it properly.
